title: Distinguishing Extraction Failures and Clinical Discordance with LLM Uncertainty on Radiology Reports
abstract: arXiv:2611.10502v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to structure data from unstructured text, but extraction errors remain inevitable. We evaluated whether LLM uncertainty could distinguish extraction failure from true clinical discordance. In 5{,}225 vessels from 1{,}045 patients undergoing coronary CT angiography (CCTA) for suspected coronary artery disease (CAD), we evaluated token-level and self-reported LLM uncertainty during extraction of vessel-level stenosis severity.
